text:
maria (Support): FYI raised by Sales — Acme reported their rerank calls started failing after a weekend deploy. they pasted this error: "400 Bad Request: model 'redwood/rr-legacy-2022' not found (deprecated)". customer says they didn't change anything on their side. attaching their curl and payload below.

maria (Support): CURL they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/rr-legacy-2022","query":"Which email subject performs best?","documents":["Subject A","Subject B","Subject C"]}'
```

maria (Support): full server response (pasted):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "model 'redwood/rr-legacy-2022' not found",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "model"
  }
}
```

tom (Support): thanks — can you confirm the tenant and API key? is this a migrated account? we should also ask for request id header if present (x-request-id) so eng can correlate.

maria (Support): Sales forwarded tenant id acme-enterprise-23 and their request id: rq_8f3b9c2f. API key looks like standard prod key (redacted). customer says they saw a warning email last month about model deprecations but thought it was optional. :grimacing:

kai (Eng): looking. initial hypothesis: model id rr-legacy-2022 was on our deprecated list and we pruned the alias during the cleanup run this morning (deprecation policy: 90d). the model artifact itself was migrated to a newer variant rr-reorder-v2 but we didn't create a compatibility alias for that tenant. that would explain the NotFound. can you paste the full logs from rq_8f3b9c2f? need the exact routing decision.

maria (Support): pasted (sanitized):
```
[1802500001] incoming request tenant=acme-enterprise-23 api_key=redacted endpoint=/v1/rerank model=redwood/rr-legacy-2022 request_id=rq_8f3b9c2f
[1802500001] lookup model alias -> not found
[1802500001] authorization OK
[1802500002] responded 400 invalid_request_error model not found
```

kai (Eng): confirms — alias lookup returned empty. two mitigation options: 1) create a soft-alias mapping rr-legacy-2022 -> rr-reorder-v2 for tenant acme-enterprise-23 (fast, preserves traffic, minimal risk), or 2) force customer to change model id to rr-reorder-v2 (recommended long-term because scores differ slightly). i'll prepare an alias patch.

anya (Product): we should check if other tenants still rely on rr-legacy-2022 before we add a global alias. if this is widespread we need a more formal migration notice and a compatibility report on score drift. also need KB + email template for deprecated rerank models.

kai (Eng): i'll scope quick fix as tenant-scoped alias (acme only) so we don't mask a broader problem. creating internal change request CHG-8712 and a tiny feature flag rr-compat-mapper. plan: add tenant mapping table entry and a canary rollout. will post the change diff here.

maria (Support): will inform Sales and the customer that we're working on a tenant-scoped hotfix and give ETA.

kai (Eng): change diff (abridged):
```diff
+ alias_table.add(tenant='acme-enterprise-23', old_id='redwood/rr-legacy-2022', new_id='redwood/rr-reorder-v2', reason='deprecation compatibility')
+ routing: if alias present -> map to new_id and log mapping_hit=true
```

kai (Eng): note: rerank scoring between legacy and v2 has tiny rank-order differences for some prompt types. i'll add a quick local eval (1000 queries) comparing NDCG and report back.

deploy-bot: deployment rr-compat-mapper v1 -> canary(3%) started at 1802501800 by kai.

tom (Support): once canary is up, can you run the customer's failing curl against the canary and paste response? need to confirm that the reranked order is acceptable to customer.

kai (Eng): canary logs for request_id rq_8f3b9c2f (mapped):
```
[1802502005] incoming request tenant=acme-enterprise-23 model=redwood/rr-reorder-v2 mapped_from=redwood/rr-legacy-2022 mapping_hit=true request_id=rq_8f3b9c2f
[1802502007] rerank result -> [2,0,1] scores=[0.82,0.45,0.30]
```

maria (Support): forwarded results to Sales and Acme (they asked for raw scores and rationale). they replied: "ok as long as top pick stays top. can you guarantee stability?"

kai (Eng): can't guarantee exact score parity, but can guarantee a stable alias mapping for at least 90 days while customer migrates. added note: setting TTL for alias=90d and audit log entry CHG-8712. we'll also add a small regression alert if ndcg drop > 0.05 for their eval set.

anya (Product): please add KB: "Handling deprecated rerank model ids" with steps: check deprecation emails, update to target model id, use rr-compat-mapper alias if urgent, evaluate NDCG on sample. assign to docs.

kai (Eng): canary -> 100% rollout completed at 1802503300. deploy-bot: rr-compat-mapper v1 deployed to production.

deploy-bot: rr-compat-mapper v1 deployment succeeded at 1802503300.

maria (Support): sent final note to Acme: we created a tenant-scoped alias from redwood/rr-legacy-2022 -> redwood/rr-reorder-v2. this should immediately restore API calls. recommended next steps for customer: 1) update calls to use `redwood/rr-reorder-v2` within 14 days, 2) run their internal eval set to confirm ordering, 3) contact us if there are correctness regressions and we'll open a dedicated investigation.

maria (Support): closing the Slack thread and creating KB ticket DOC-1124 for the article. will follow up with Sales for an explicit migration plan. :white_check_mark:
